items.label: SEC civil: State Street Bank and Trust Company
items.detail: Settlement of SEC charges of misleading investors in the Limited Duration Bond Fund about subprime exposure; date is the announcement date. Amount is the stated sum of a $50 million penalty, more than $8.3 million disgorgement and interest, and more than $255 million investor payments (stated as floors). Parallel Massachusetts Securities Division and MA-AG actions are separate (see rel:ma-ag-2010-state-street:1, which overlaps this money); about $350 million of private settlements not counted.
